slug: 纯阳霸体绝美师尊求与我修炼
content_zh:
洛安城。苏家别院。
苏铭猛地睁眼，只觉脑袋一阵昏沉。
刚一回神，便瞧见一张绝美脸蛋近在咫尺。
那女子，肤如凝脂，双眸含情似秋水，眉若远黛，琼鼻挺翘，樱唇不点而朱，身材更是凹凸有致，前凸后翘，简直就是天生尤物。
此刻，这绝美的女人正压在他身上。
苏铭瞬间清醒，使劲挣扎，“你谁啊？咋压我身上！”
女子轻启朱唇，声音如黄莺出谷，“苏铭，是我，林念瑶。”
林念瑶？洛安城四大家族之一林家的大小姐？苏铭心中满是疑惑，这大小姐咋跑自己这儿，还压自己身上了？
“林大小姐，你这是干啥？快起来！”苏铭又用力推了推，却发现浑身软绵绵的，使不上劲。
林念瑶嘴角勾起一抹浅笑，“苏铭，我给你下了药，药效已经发作咯，你就乖乖从了我吧。”
苏铭瞪大双眼，满脸震惊，“你疯啦！为啥要这么干？”
林念瑶眼眸闪过一丝复杂神色，“我不想嫁给秦家二少爷，只能借你破坏这婚约。”
苏铭一听，气得不行，“那也不能用这法子啊！你快给我解药！”
林念瑶却不为所动，手指轻轻划过苏铭脸庞，“苏铭，你不知道，我打小就喜欢你，今日，算是老天给我的机会。”
苏铭心中一乱，他可从来不知道林念瑶喜欢自己。可即便如此，被下药强迫这事，他哪能接受？
“不行，我不接受！林念瑶，你别乱来！”苏铭拼命摇头，可身体愈发不受控制。
林念瑶凑近，在他耳边吹气如兰，“晚了，从现在起，你就是我的人了，看秦家还怎么逼我嫁人。”
苏铭心中叫苦不迭，重生这十八年，一心修仙，奈何天赋不行，压根跨入不了修炼的门槛，只能整日游乐，成了苏家人口中的废柴大少爷。
虽说日子过得自在，却也常遭人白眼，提起苏家，旁人都只夸老二老三天赋厉害。本想着日子就这么浑浑噩噩过下去也不算差，哪曾想，今儿个竟碰上这等荒唐事！
“林念瑶，你别太过分！”苏铭咬牙切齿，可声音却没了底气。

林念瑶咯咯笑了起来，那笑声在这房间里回荡，却让苏铭愈发绝望，只能眼睁睁看着林念瑶对自己无礼……
苏铭悠悠转醒。
只见点点落红。
心中猛地一紧，林念瑶呢？竟已没了踪影。
此刻，他只觉身体仿若被抽干，空虚之感如汹涌潮水，疯狂席卷而来。
“这林念瑶，简直就是个疯子！”苏铭忍不住低声咒骂。
她竟借自己之手，搅黄了林家与秦家的联姻，这胆子，也忒大了些！
苏铭满心都是不可置信。
他怎么也想不到，林念瑶居然从小就喜欢自己，这唱的又是哪出啊？
“这下可好，怕是要被卷进林、秦两家那堆破事儿里了。”苏铭眉头紧紧皱起，内心满是无奈。
content_en:
Luo'an City. The Su Family Courtyard.
Su Ming opened his eyes suddenly and felt his head feel dizzy.
As soon as he regained consciousness, he saw a beautiful face close at hand.
That woman had skin as smooth as gelatin, eyes as affectionate as autumn water, eyebrows as far away as dark blue, a straight nose, pink lips that were not dotted, and a curvy figure, with the front protruding and the back curving. She was simply a natural beauty.
At this moment, this beautiful woman was pressing on him.
Su Ming woke up instantly and struggled hard, "Who are you? Why are you pressing on me!"
The woman opened her red lips lightly, and her voice was like an oriole coming out of the valley, "Su Ming, it's me, Lin Nianyao."
Lin Nianyao? The eldest lady of the Lin family, one of the four major families in Luo'an City? Su Ming's heart was full of doubts, why did this young lady come to him and press on him?
"Miss Lin, what are you doing? Get up!" Su Ming pushed hard again, but found that his whole body was limp and he couldn't exert any strength.
A faint smile appeared on Lin Nianyao's lips, "Su Ming, I gave you the medicine. The effects of the medicine have already taken effect. Just obey me."
Su Ming's eyes widened with shock on his face, "Are you crazy! Why do you do this?"
Lin Nianyao's eyes flashed with a complicated look, "I don't want to marry the second young master of the Qin family, so I can only use you to break this engagement."
When Su Ming heard this, he was extremely angry, "You can't use this method! Give me the antidote!"
Lin Nianyao was unmoved, her fingers lightly crossed Su Ming's face, "Su Ming, you don't know, I have liked you since I was a child. Today is the opportunity God gave me."
Su Ming was confused. He never knew that Lin Nianyao liked him. But even so, how could he accept being drugged and forced?
"No, I won't accept it! Lin Nianyao, don't do this!" Su Ming shook his head desperately, but his body became more and more out of control.
Lin Nianyao came closer and blew Rulan into his ear, "It's too late. From now on, you are mine. Let's see how the Qin family continues to force me to marry."
Su Ming complained endlessly in his heart. In the past eighteen years since his rebirth, he had devoted himself to cultivating immortality. However, his talent was not good enough and he could not cross the threshold of cultivation. He could only play around all day long and became what the Su family called a good-for-nothing young master.
Although he lived a comfortable life, he was often looked down upon by others. When talking about the Su family, others only praised the second and third children for their great talents. I thought it wouldn't be too bad to live in such a hazy life, but I never thought that I would encounter such a ridiculous thing today!
"Lin Nianyao, don't go too far!" Su Ming gritted his teeth, but his voice lost confidence.
Lin Nianyao chuckled. The laughter echoed in the room, but it made Su Ming more desperate. He could only watch Lin Nianyao being rude to him...
Su Ming woke up leisurely.
All I saw was a little bit of red.
My heart suddenly tightened, where is Lin Nianyao? There was no trace.
At this moment, he felt as if his body had been drained dry, and the feeling of emptiness was like a surging tide, sweeping over him madly.
"This Lin Nianyao is simply a lunatic!" Su Ming couldn't help but curse in a low voice.
She actually used her own hands to disrupt the marriage between the Lin family and the Qin family. She was so courageous!
Su Ming was filled with disbelief.
He never imagined that Lin Nianyao had liked him since he was a child. Where did this song come from?
"This is a good time. I'm afraid I will be involved in the mess between Lin and Qin's family." Su Ming frowned tightly, feeling helpless in his heart.
